hero.body: downDATA watches the status pages you already depend on — GitHub, Supabase, Cloudflare, and anything else on Atlassian Statuspage — checked as often as every {{interval}}, starting at {{price}} where StatusGator charges {{competitorPrice}} for the same job.
hero.noCard: No credit card. Full access for 14 days.

features.heading: Cheaper because the bill behind it is smaller.
features.subtitle: Competitor pricing partly pays for phone/SMS infrastructure and multi-region probe networks we don't carry the same way.
features.speedBody: Starter checks every 15s, Pro every 10s. UptimeRobot's cheapest paid plan only manages 60s.
features.seatsBody: UptimeRobot charges $15–19/month per teammate past the first three. Here, the whole team is included.
features.selfHostedBody: Run it on your own box for a flat fee. None of the five competitors we checked offer that at all.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Instead, a real 14-day trial with full access — no card required. Pick a plan when you're ready, not before.
pricing.businessNote: SSO, audit logs, and priority support are still being built. Leave your email and we'll tell you the day it ships.
pricing.needMore: Need more than 1,000 monitors, or want to run it yourself?

closing.heading: Fourteen days. Full access. No card.

landing.footer: Status data sourced from each provider's public Statuspage API.
